candidate: Canny plus probabilistic-Hough corroboration of existing OpenCV-LSD P0 candidates

execution.dependency: OpenCV only; no external model, download, or persistent process
execution.candidate_match: axis angle <= 7.5 degrees; finite-segment distance <= 4 analysis pixels; overlap >= 30 percent of the shorter segment
execution.selection: maximize development target-localization recall, then minimize development clean candidate count; holdout never selects parameters

decision.reason: The selected setting reduced clean review candidates on development, but collapsed unseen holdout target localization from 6/6 to 2/6. Independent low-level detector agreement is therefore not a reliable proxy for a semantically meaningful geometric relation in this benchmark.
decision.scope: This is a P0 review-candidate localization screen, not AI-origin classification.
